title: Trigger record
description: The harness's TRIGGER record: why a turn happened, and the hash of the bundle served for it (CONTRACT.md v0.6 §6.1, §12; the Director's ruling on U21, 26 October 2026). The trigger list is recorded with each turn (§6.1). bundle_sha256 is what the turn's COMMAND_REQUEST carries as agent_input_hash, so evaluation can match a request to the bundle ODIN saw.

triggers.description: As the bundle carries them (§16.1 U1).

bundle_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the exact turn-bundle bytes the harness served.
